title: Control systems
circuit: G(s) = K / (s(s+2)) in unity negative feedback, K set by the student (key at K = 4)

candidates.name: PathView + PathSim
candidates.oneLine: Hosted Simulink-style block editor, PathSim in Pyodide, our .pvm model loaded by URL.
candidates.accuracy: In-embed scope peak 1.1630331 (OS 16.303 %); same .pvm via pvm2py in CPython PathSim gives identical trace, Ts(2 %) 4.04 s.
candidates.caveats: Third-party hosted site and CDN; Run ready after ~21 s; editor panels crowd a phone; no viewer mode; params are Python expressions.

candidates.name: Pad-native root locus (JSXGraph)
candidates.oneLine: Drag closed-loop poles along the root locus; step response and readouts follow live.
candidates.accuracy: check-control-core.mjs: 31/31 PASS vs python-control (poles, OS 16.303 %, PM 51.827°, ωgc 1.5723, Ts, K = 1/2/8/16).
candidates.caveats: JSXGraph is 946 KB ungzipped here; locus arrows placed for this plant; Ts readout is 4/ζωn, true 2 % time shown as red tick.

candidates.name: Pad-native frequency response (Plotly)
candidates.oneLine: Bode with phase margin marked, Nyquist and step, K slider; optional in-page python-control check.
candidates.accuracy: Same core, 31/31 PASS in Node; in-page python-control 0.10.2 check agreed on six values to within 3e-5.
candidates.caveats: Plotly is 4.7 MB ungzipped; the python-control button costs ~33 MB and ~26 s; phone shows one view at a time behind tabs.
